mapper.sql: r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation r JOIN com_contract c ON c.id = r.contract_id AND c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE AND ((o.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) = CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_order_contract_relation oc WHERE oc.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND oc.order_id = o.id AND oc.contract_id = c.id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (oc.effective_to IS NULL OR oc.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))))
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM com_contract c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation r WHERE r.contract_id = c.id AND ) ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.*, () AS contract_associated, o.authority_status AS order_authority_status, o.source_lifecycle_status AS order_lifecycle_status, o.status AS order_status FROM com_sales_order_line l JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE l.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND l.deleted = 0 AND ((o.order_type = '0' AND ) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_delivery_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND s.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s.order_line_id = l.id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.effective_to IS NULL)) ORDER BY l.id FOR UPDATE
